skills.name: brand
skills.description: Brand kits and brand templates in Canva through Canva's official MCP server - the person's or their school's colours, fonts and templates, a design from a brand template and its fillable fields, drafting and publishing a template - and what to offer on a Canva plan without them. Use when the person wants a design in their own or their school's style, or asks about brand kits or templates.

skills.name: designs
skills.description: Work the person's Canva designs through Canva's official MCP server - finding them, creating one from a description, a copy, another size or a file, editing texts, images and pages, folders and comments - knowing what needs the person's yes and what their Canva plan allows. Use whenever the person asks for a presentation, poster, infographic, worksheet or any other Canva design, or to find, change or comment on one.

skills.name: export
skills.description: Export the person's Canva designs through Canva's official MCP server - which format for which use (PDF to print, PNG or JPG for images, PPTX for slides, MP4 or GIF for video, CSV for data), the Free plan's quality, premium elements, and that the download link expires. Use when the person wants a design as a file, to print, to put in a course or to send.

skills.name: images
skills.description: Images for the person's Canva designs through Canva's official MCP server - generating or editing one from a description, removing a background, separating a flat image into editable layers, uploading the person's files to Canva and reading a design's images - with what needs their yes and what never to upload. Use when the person asks for a picture, an illustration, a background removed or a file of theirs in a Canva design.

skills.name: what-goes-to-canva
skills.description: What may and may not be sent to Canva through its MCP server - everything sent leaves this computer for Canva's servers and the person's account, so students' and other people's personal data (names, class lists, grades, photos, certificates) never goes without the person's explicit yes. Use before any Canva call that carries names, a list of people, grades, photos of people or a document about someone, and whenever the person asks to make certificates, class lists, seating plans or anything with other people's data in Canva.

extensions.name: docker-lab
extensions.description: Docker as a lab for your agent: it runs and tries software (tools, services, someone's code) in isolated containers without touching your computer, verifies that things work by running them, and manages your Docker, through docker-mcp, in the mode you choose (only read, only labs, or everything).

descriptions.en: Docker as a lab for your agent: it runs and tries software (tools, services, someone's code) in isolated containers without touching your computer, verifies that things work by running them, and manages your Docker, through docker-mcp, in the mode you choose (only read, only labs, or everything).
descriptions.es: Docker como laboratorio para tu agente: ejecuta y prueba software (herramientas, servicios, código ajeno) en contenedores aislados sin tocar tu ordenador, comprueba que las cosas funcionan ejecutándolas y gestiona tu Docker, a través de docker-mcp, en el modo que elijas (solo mirar, solo laboratorios o todo).

extensions.author: Falken's Lab

en.label: Containers
en.description: Run, inspect, follow, measure and clean up containers, asking before anything dangerous.

es.label: Contenedores
es.description: Arrancar, inspeccionar, seguir, medir y limpiar contenedores, preguntando antes de lo peligroso.

en.label: Images
en.description: Pull, build, tag and push images, with your own registry login.

es.label: Imágenes
es.description: Descargar, construir, etiquetar y subir imágenes, con tu propio login en el registro.

en.label: Compose projects
en.description: Build, start, follow and stop Compose projects.

es.label: Proyectos de Compose
es.description: Construir, arrancar, seguir y parar proyectos de Compose.

en.label: Volumes, networks and clean-ups
en.description: Volumes and networks, Docker's disk usage, and cleaning up what isn't used.

es.label: Volúmenes, redes y limpieza
es.description: Volúmenes y redes, el disco que usa Docker y limpiar lo que no se usa.

en.label: Software lab
en.description: Run and try tools, services and someone's code in isolated labs, without installing anything on your computer: no internet, no host mounts, with limits.

es.label: Laboratorio de software
es.description: Ejecutar y probar herramientas, servicios y código ajeno en laboratorios aislados, sin instalar nada en tu ordenador: sin internet, sin montar el equipo, con límites.

en.label: Verifying by running
en.description: Whether code, instructions, a statement and its solution or a submission work, by running them in a lab, with a verdict and its evidence.

es.label: Verificar ejecutando
es.description: Si un código, unas instrucciones, un enunciado y su solución o una entrega funcionan, ejecutándolos en un laboratorio, con un veredicto y sus pruebas.

skills.name: build-a-lab
skills.description: Build a reproducible docker-mcp lab - a folder with a compose.yaml of one or more services that passes the labs' safety policy, the files it works on, and a lab.json check that says whether it works - and run it through its life: start, work inside, reset, stop. Use when an environment with several services is needed (a web app with its database, a practice for a course, a setup to reproduce a problem), or to start, reset or stop an existing lab.

skills.name: try-in-a-lab
skills.description: Try a tool, a service or a piece of code in a disposable docker-mcp lab instead of installing or running it on the person's computer - pick a pinned image, write a minimal lab, run it under the labs' safety policy, report what happened with evidence, and clean up. Use whenever something needs running or trying (a program, a database, a command-line tool, a script, someone's code) and it isn't installed, or shouldn't run on the real machine.

skills.name: use-docker
skills.description: Work the person's Docker with docker-mcp - containers, images, volumes, networks, Compose projects, disk usage and clean-ups - knowing what its mode allows, what to confirm first, the dangerous options that need an explicit yes, and how to explain a missing or stopped Docker. Use whenever the person asks for anything about their Docker that isn't trying something in a lab.

skills.name: verify-by-running
skills.description: Verify that something works by running it in a docker-mcp lab rather than by reading it - code, a script, a set of instructions followed step by step, a statement and its solution, or someone's submission - and give a clear verdict with evidence; write lab.json checks that say what failed. Use whenever anyone asks whether something works, before trusting or handing out instructions or code, or to write or improve a lab's check.

labels.es: Leyendo los logs de un proyecto de Compose
Midiendo lo que consumen los contenedores
Midiendo el disco que usa Docker

labels.en: Running a command in the lab {lab}
labels.es: Ejecutando una orden en el laboratorio {lab}

extensions.name: h5p
extensions.description: Interactive H5P content for your agent: multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, drag the words, cards, question sets and course presentations, built as content-only .h5p packages on your computer, checked before they're written, through h5p-mcp.

descriptions.en: Interactive H5P content for your agent: multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, drag the words, cards, question sets and course presentations, built as content-only .h5p packages on your computer, checked before they're written, through h5p-mcp.
descriptions.es: Contenido interactivo H5P para tu agente: opción múltiple, verdadero o falso, rellenar huecos, arrastrar palabras, tarjetas, conjuntos de preguntas y presentaciones, como paquetes .h5p solo con el contenido, en tu ordenador y comprobados antes de escribirlos, a través de h5p-mcp.

extensions.author: Falken's Lab

en.label: Interactive H5P content
en.description: Questions, gap texts, cards, question sets and slides as .h5p packages ready to upload, checked first and in your language, with a preview to review them.

es.label: Contenido interactivo H5P
es.description: Preguntas, textos con huecos, tarjetas, conjuntos de preguntas y diapositivas como paquetes .h5p listos para subir, comprobados antes y en tu idioma, con una vista previa para revisarlos.

skills.name: h5p-packages
skills.description: Build interactive H5P content as a package with h5p-mcp - multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, drag the words, Dialog Cards, Flashcards, a Question Set or a Course Presentation - in the shape each type's fields take, checked before it's written, in the content's language, with a preview to review before uploading; and read an existing .h5p to review or change it. Use when the person asks for an H5P activity or package, an interactive exercise or self-check that a site such as Moodle plays, or to look inside or edit an .h5p file.

labels.en: Looking at the H5P content types
labels.es: Mirando los tipos de contenido H5P

extensions.name: moodle-student
extensions.description: Work in your Moodle courses as a student, through moodle-mcp: what you have left and when, assignments, quizzes, forums and the other activities, your grades and feedback, with how to do each well in Moodle.

descriptions.en: Work in your Moodle courses as a student, through moodle-mcp: what you have left and when, assignments, quizzes, forums and the other activities, your grades and feedback, with how to do each well in Moodle.
descriptions.es: Trabaja en tus cursos de Moodle como alumno, a través de moodle-mcp: lo que te queda y para cuándo, tareas, cuestionarios, foros y las demás actividades, tus notas y la retroalimentación, con cómo hacer bien cada cosa en Moodle.

extensions.author: Falken's Lab

en.label: Reading a course
en.description: Sections, resources and activities, what's locked and why, and what counts as done.

es.label: Leer un curso
es.description: Secciones, recursos y actividades, qué está bloqueado y por qué, y qué cuenta como hecho.

en.label: Planning your work
en.description: What's left, deadlines and cut-offs, and what unlocks what, in a realistic order.

es.label: Organizar tu trabajo
es.description: Lo que queda, las fechas de entrega y de corte, y qué desbloquea qué, en un orden realista.

en.label: Handing in assignments
en.description: What it accepts, saving, checking and submitting for good, only with your yes.

es.label: Entregar tareas
es.description: Qué admite, guardar, comprobar y enviar definitivamente, solo con tu sí.

en.label: Taking quizzes
en.description: The rules before starting, answering each question type, submitting with your yes, and the review.

es.label: Hacer cuestionarios
es.description: Las reglas antes de empezar, responder cada tipo de pregunta, enviar con tu sí, y la revisión.

en.label: Taking part in forums
en.description: Reading threads, asking where it belongs, posting exactly once, and writing to the teacher.

es.label: Participar en los foros
es.description: Leer los hilos, preguntar donde corresponde, publicar una sola vez y escribir al docente.

en.label: Other activities
en.description: Choices, surveys, lessons, SCORM, H5P, workshops (submitting and peer assessment), glossary, wiki and database entries, badges and manual completion.

es.label: Otras actividades
es.description: Consultas, encuestas, lecciones, SCORM, H5P, talleres (entregar y evaluar a compañeros), entradas de glosario, wiki y base de datos, insignias y finalización manual.

en.label: Grades and feedback
en.description: Your grade report, each activity's feedback, and what's still to be graded.

es.label: Notas y retroalimentación
es.description: Tu informe de calificaciones, la retroalimentación de cada actividad y lo que falta por corregir.

en.label: Several Moodle sites
en.description: Adding and switching sites, kept apart.

es.label: Varios sitios Moodle
es.description: Añadir sitios y cambiar de uno a otro, por separado.

skills.name: forums
skills.description: Take part in a Moodle course's forums as a student with moodle-mcp - read threads whole, check a question hasn't been asked already, find the right forum, post or reply exactly once with the person's yes, edit within the allowed time, subscriptions and ratings, and write to the teacher privately. Use whenever the person reads, asks, replies or posts in a Moodle forum, or wants to write to their teacher.

skills.name: grades-and-feedback
skills.description: Read a student's grades and feedback in Moodle with moodle-mcp - the grade report with weights and contributions, each assignment's grade, comments and feedback files, each quiz attempt's review, and what's still to be graded - and explain where the person stands. Use when the person asks how they're doing, what they got, what the teacher said, or how much an activity counts.

skills.name: hand-in-an-assignment
skills.description: Hand in a Moodle assignment as a student with moodle-mcp - read what it asks and accepts, download its files, save the submission (online text or files), check it, and submit it for good only with the person's yes, including the submission statement, drafts, resubmissions and group work. Use whenever the person works on, saves, changes or submits an assignment, or asks whether it was received.

skills.name: other-activities
skills.description: Do Moodle's other activities as a student with moodle-mcp - choices (polls), surveys and feedback, lessons page by page, SCORM packages, H5P, a workshop (submitting and assessing classmates), glossary, wiki and database entries, badges, and marking activities as done - knowing which answers are final and checking what Moodle recorded. Use whenever the person answers a choice or survey, goes through a lesson, plays a SCORM or H5P activity, works in a workshop, writes in a glossary, wiki or database, or marks an activity complete.

skills.name: plan-my-work
skills.description: Find what a student has left in their Moodle courses with moodle-mcp - pending activities, deadlines and cut-offs, overdue work, what unlocks what, grades so far - and order it into a realistic plan by date and by dependency. Use when the person asks what they have to do, what's due, where they stand in a course, or what to do next.

skills.name: read-a-course
skills.description: Read a Moodle course as a student with moodle-mcp - its sections, resources and activities, what's open or locked and why, what counts as done, the files and texts to study, and what changed lately - instead of guessing from names or from memory. Use before working on a course, and whenever unsure what a course holds, what an activity asks or why something can't be opened.

skills.name: several-sites
skills.description: Work with several Moodle sites through moodle-mcp as a student - which one is active, adding and switching sites, and keeping courses, ids and aliases apart per site. Use when the person mentions another Moodle (their school's and their university's, a training platform), or asks to add or switch sites.

skills.name: take-a-quiz
skills.description: Take a Moodle quiz as a student with moodle-mcp - read its rules first (attempts, time limit, grading, dates), start an attempt only with the person's yes, answer each question type in the fields Moodle expects, check every answer, submit for good with their yes, and learn from the review. Use whenever the person attempts, continues, submits or reviews a quiz.

skills.name: week
skills.description: What a student has to do this week in their Moodle courses - deadlines including overdue ones still accepted, what is left and what is locked, unread notifications - in a short list by day, only reading. Use when the person asks what they have to do or hand in this week (or in the next days).

extensions.name: moodle-teacher
extensions.description: Work in your Moodle courses as their teacher, through moodle-mcp: building them, grading, following the class, checking and reusing courses, with how to do each well in Moodle.

descriptions.en: Work in your Moodle courses as their teacher, through moodle-mcp: building them, grading, following the class, checking and reusing courses, with how to do each well in Moodle.
descriptions.es: Trabaja en tus cursos de Moodle como docente, a través de moodle-mcp: construirlos, calificar, seguir a la clase, revisar y reutilizar cursos, con cómo hacer bien cada cosa en Moodle.

extensions.author: Falken's Lab

en.label: Reading a course
en.description: What you can do in a course, its sections, activities, restrictions, completion and dates, as Moodle has them now.

es.label: Leer un curso
es.description: Qué puedes hacer en un curso, sus secciones, actividades, restricciones, finalización y fechas, tal como están ahora en Moodle.

en.label: Publishing safely
en.description: New content goes up hidden, is checked, and is shown only with your yes; one approval per item.

es.label: Publicar con seguridad
es.description: Lo nuevo se sube oculto, se comprueba y solo se muestra con tu sí; una aprobación por cada cosa.

en.label: Course content
en.description: Pages, books with their chapters, files, folders, links and section texts, as HTML checked before Moodle gets it.

es.label: Contenidos del curso
es.description: Páginas, libros con sus capítulos, archivos, carpetas, enlaces y textos de sección, en un HTML comprobado antes de llegar a Moodle.

en.label: Assignments
en.description: Submission settings that match the statement (files and formats, dates and cut-off, groups, feedback and grade), and its rubric or marking guide.

es.label: Tareas
es.description: Ajustes de entrega que encajan con el enunciado (archivos y formatos, fechas y fecha límite, grupos, retroalimentación y nota), y su rúbrica o guía de calificación.

en.label: Quizzes
en.description: Settings for the quiz's purpose, questions checked and imported from GIFT or Moodle XML or exported to reuse, their order, pages and total.

es.label: Cuestionarios
es.description: Ajustes según el propósito del cuestionario, preguntas comprobadas e importadas en GIFT o Moodle XML o exportadas para reutilizarlas, su orden, sus páginas y el total.

en.label: Other activities
en.description: Workshops with their allocation, lessons with their pages and jumps, databases, glossaries, wikis, feedback, forums, choices and H5P, with completion, restrictions, groups and badges.

es.label: Otras actividades
es.description: Talleres con su asignación, lecciones con sus páginas y saltos, bases de datos, glosarios, wikis, encuestas, foros, consultas y H5P, con finalización, restricciones, grupos e insignias.

en.label: Running the forums
en.description: Reading threads, replying and announcing exactly once, and moderating.

es.label: Llevar los foros
es.description: Leer los hilos, responder y publicar avisos una sola vez, y moderar.

en.label: Grading
en.description: Assignments with their rubric or guide, quiz essays and graded forums: proposals first, and only what you approve is saved.

es.label: Corregir
es.description: Tareas con su rúbrica o guía, preguntas de ensayo y foros calificados: primero las propuestas, y solo se guarda lo que apruebas.

en.label: The gradebook
en.description: Categories, aggregation and weights that compute your grading scheme, checked against it.

es.label: El libro de calificaciones
es.description: Categorías, agregación y pesos que calculan tu sistema de calificación, comprobados con él.

en.label: Following the class
en.description: Who's falling behind and on what, from completion, grades, submissions and activity, and writing to them.

es.label: Seguir a la clase
es.description: Quién se queda atrás y en qué, a partir de la finalización, las notas, las entregas y la actividad, y escribirles.

en.label: Checking a course
en.description: What's broken or stale (locked activities, dates, gradebook weights) and getting a course ready for a new term.

es.label: Revisar un curso
es.description: Lo que está roto o desfasado (actividades bloqueadas, fechas, pesos del calificador) y preparar un curso para una nueva edición.

en.label: SCORM packages
en.description: An HTML activity packaged as SCORM 1.2, uploaded, replaced in place and set up so Moodle records completion and a score.

es.label: Paquetes SCORM
es.description: Una actividad HTML empaquetada como SCORM 1.2, subida, sustituida en su sitio y configurada para que Moodle registre la finalización y la nota.

en.label: Copying courses
en.description: Copying, importing, backing up and restoring courses, checking the result, and reading or anonymizing a backup file.

es.label: Copiar cursos
es.description: Copiar, importar, hacer copias de seguridad y restaurar cursos, comprobar el resultado, y leer o anonimizar una copia de seguridad.

en.label: Several Moodle sites
en.description: Adding and switching sites, and copying content from one to another.

es.label: Varios sitios Moodle
es.description: Añadir sitios, cambiar de uno a otro y copiar contenidos entre ellos.

en.label: Participants and groups
en.description: Enrolling people and their roles, how the course lets people in, and making and filling groups.

es.label: Participantes y grupos
es.description: Matricular a personas y sus roles, cómo se entra en el curso, y crear y llenar grupos.

en.label: The course calendar
en.description: Course events everyone in the course sees, and what's coming.

es.label: El calendario del curso
es.description: Eventos del curso que ven todos sus participantes, y lo que está por llegar.

en.label: Course completion
en.description: What completes the course, who has completed it, and marking it by hand.

es.label: Finalización del curso
es.description: Qué completa el curso, quién lo ha completado y marcarlo a mano.

skills.name: assignments
skills.description: Create or reconfigure a Moodle assignment with moodle-mcp so its statement, its submission settings and its grading agree - submission types, files and formats, dates and cut-off, groups, attempts, feedback types, grade, marking workflow, rubric - and change one safely once students have submitted. Use whenever an assignment is created or its settings change.

skills.name: class-progress
skills.description: Read how a Moodle class is doing with moodle-mcp - completion, grades, submissions, quiz results, who hasn't accessed the course, participation and views - telling what Moodle says from what it doesn't, and write to the students concerned with the person's yes. Use when the person asks who's falling behind, how a group or an activity is going, or for a progress report.

skills.name: copy-and-restore
skills.description: Reuse Moodle course content with moodle-mcp - copy a course, import activities from another course, back up to a .mbz and restore it, read or anonymize a .mbz on this computer, and check the result. Use when the person asks to reuse last year's course, copy activities, back up or restore a course, look inside or share a backup file, or prepare a course for a new term.

skills.name: course-check
skills.description: Check a Moodle course for what's broken or inconsistent in Moodle itself with moodle-mcp - restrictions pointing nowhere, dates out of order or from last year, empty or forgotten hidden sections, quizzes that show answers during the attempt, assignments that can't take what they ask or save feedback, missing rubrics, gradebook weights, completion - and prepare a course for a new term. Use when the person asks to review, audit or tidy a course, or to get it ready for a new edition.

skills.name: course-content
skills.description: Put learning content into a Moodle course with moodle-mcp - choose the resource (page, book, file, folder, URL, text and media area, section summary), write it as HTML Moodle keeps, embed images and upload files, and edit existing content without breaking it. Use whenever notes, documents, links or section texts go into Moodle or change there; activities have their own skills.

skills.name: forums
skills.description: Work a Moodle course's forums with moodle-mcp - find what's unanswered, read whole threads, reply or post announcements exactly once, edit or delete a post, pin and lock discussions, subscriptions, ratings and messages to several participants. Use whenever reading, answering or posting in a Moodle forum, or writing to the class.

skills.name: gradebook
skills.description: Set up and check a Moodle course's gradebook with moodle-mcp so the final grade is computed as the person's grading scheme says - categories, aggregation, weights, each activity's maximum grade, manual grade items, overrides, and the grader report - decided before the first graded activity rather than repaired after the last. Use when a course's weights or grading scheme are set up, changed or checked, when graded activities are created, or when grades are exported.

skills.name: grading
skills.description: Grade in Moodle with moodle-mcp - assignment submissions with their rubric, marking guide or simple grade, quiz questions graded by hand, whole-forum grades - proposing first and saving only what the person approves, with feedback that's really saved, group submissions, missing work, extensions and the marking workflow. Use when the person asks to grade, mark or give feedback on an assignment, a quiz's essays or a graded forum.

skills.name: other-activities
skills.description: Set up Moodle's other activities with moodle-mcp so they behave as intended - workshop (peer assessment) and its phases, lesson, glossary, wiki, database, forum types and whole-forum grading, choice, feedback survey, H5P, SCORM - and the pieces that connect activities - completion, access restrictions, groups and groupings, badges. Use when a course needs something other than a resource, an assignment or a quiz, or when activities must unlock, track or group.

skills.name: participants-and-groups
skills.description: Manage who is in a Moodle course and how they're grouped, with moodle-mcp - enrolment methods (manual, self enrolment with a key, guest access), enrolling and unenrolling people, their roles, groups and groupings, creating groups automatically or from a CSV, and what each change does in Moodle. Use when the person asks to enrol or remove someone, give a role, open the course with a key, or make, fill or change groups.

skills.name: publishing
skills.description: Put new content in a Moodle course safely with moodle-mcp - hidden first, checked, then shown with the person's yes - and change what students already see in place; one approval per new item, read back after every write. Use whenever something new goes into a course (a section, a resource, an activity, questions, a rubric) or something visible changes.

skills.name: quizzes
skills.description: Build or change a Moodle quiz with moodle-mcp - its settings for what it's for (dates, time limit, attempts, grading method, question behaviour, review options), questions in a bank (imported as GIFT or Moodle XML, or one by one), fixed or random slots, order, pages, marks and the total - and change one safely once it has attempts. Use whenever a quiz or its questions are created or modified, or a question bank is turned into a test.

skills.name: read-a-course
skills.description: Read a Moodle course's real state with moodle-mcp before acting on it - what the person can do there, its sections and activities, restrictions and completion, dates, the gradebook and what changed lately - instead of guessing from names or from memory. Use before any complex task in a course (grading, building, auditing, reporting), and whenever unsure what a course holds or allows.

skills.name: scorm
skills.description: Turn a web activity (an HTML game, a simulation, an interactive exercise) into a SCORM 1.2 package Moodle tracks - completion and a score in the gradebook - and upload, set up and test it with moodle-mcp. Use when the person wants an HTML activity graded or tracked in Moodle, or asks for SCORM.

skills.name: several-sites
skills.description: Work with several Moodle sites through moodle-mcp - which one is active, adding and switching sites, and copying course content from one site to another with copy_between_sites. Use when the person mentions another Moodle (their school's and their university's, last year's site), asks to add a site, or to bring content from one site to another.

skills.name: to-grade
skills.description: What is waiting to be graded in one Moodle course or in all the person teaches - submissions not graded yet, quiz questions graded by hand, whole-forum grades - as a table with how long the oldest has waited, only reading, then offering to start. Use when the person asks what they have to grade or correct.

skills.name: week
skills.description: What this week holds in the Moodle courses the person teaches - the dates coming up, what is waiting to be graded, and unread notifications - in a short list by day, only reading. Use when the person asks what is due or pending this week (or in the next days), or invokes it to start the week.

extensions.name: moodle-ui-kit
extensions.description: A clean visual style for what your agent publishes in Moodle: assignment statements, code blocks, solutions, quiz questions and feedback, with inline styles that work on any Moodle site. Based on noeper's moodle-ui-kit.

descriptions.en: A clean visual style for what your agent publishes in Moodle: assignment statements, code blocks, solutions, quiz questions and feedback, with inline styles that work on any Moodle site. Based on noeper's moodle-ui-kit.
descriptions.es: Un estilo visual limpio para lo que tu agente publica en Moodle: enunciados de tareas, bloques de código, soluciones, preguntas de cuestionario y retroalimentación, con estilos en línea que funcionan en cualquier sitio Moodle. Basado en el moodle-ui-kit de noeper.

extensions.author: Falken's Lab

en.label: A visual style for Moodle
en.description: Assignment statements, code blocks, solutions, quiz questions and feedback with inline styles, from noeper's moodle-ui-kit.

es.label: Un estilo visual para Moodle
es.description: Enunciados de tareas, bloques de código, soluciones, preguntas y retroalimentación con estilos inline, del moodle-ui-kit de noeper.

skills.name: style-content
skills.description: Give what's published in Moodle a clean visual style with moodle-ui-kit's templates - an assignment's statement (goal, statement, deliverable), code blocks, a solution with its explanation, a quiz question's text and its feedback - all with inline styles, so it works on Moodle sites that strip CSS. Use when writing an assignment, a page, a label, a quiz question or feedback for Moodle and the person wants this style, or the course has no style of its own to follow.

extensions.name: weather
extensions.description: The weather in your city, for an agent that plans with you: today and the next days. Also agent-kit's example of an extension with its own MCP server.

descriptions.en: The weather in your city, for an agent that plans with you: today and the next days. Also agent-kit's example of an extension with its own MCP server.

en.label: The weather

skills.name: plan-the-day
skills.description: Plan the person's day or week around the weather - check the forecast first, then suggest when to do what. Use when they ask what to do today, when to go out, or to plan outdoor activities.
